name: Widespread rainfall 08
provenance: Modeled demonstration data — dates are illustrative
description: Generated demonstration field using the MRMS-labeled illustrative model variant. No MRMS records are downloaded or represented. Dates are fictional catalog labels.

georeference.name: MHFD district boundary — interim study-area proxy
georeference.coordinate_mapping: Easting_m = origin_easting_m + x_km * 1000; Northing_m = origin_northing_m + y_km * 1000. Grid axes are cell centers.
georeference.placement: Modeled rainfall placed over the Denver region for demonstration; not observed rainfall.
georeference.study_boundary_status: Published MHFD district boundary is an interim proxy; project-specific study boundary pending.
georeference.metrics_domain: Full 100 x 100 km projected grid; no district-boundary clipping or masking. Areas are planar UTM grid areas.
georeference.bearing_reference: UTM grid north, not geodetic true north.

methodology.depth_area_note: Exploratory concentration curve: cumulative cell depths ranked descending, then averaged over increasing area. Not a validated engineering ARF; selected cells need not be contiguous.
methodology.tracking_note: Intensity-weighted centroids of cells ≥0.1 mm/h. Drift speed uses consecutive active intervals only; dry gaps are not bridged. Bearing uses first-to-last active centroid. Growth, decay, multiple cells and boundary clipping affect centroid drift; it is not physical storm velocity.
methodology.integration_note: Rates are interval averages in mm/h; each interval contributes rate × timestep, including the last. Domain means include dry cells. x increases east and y increases north; axes are cell centers in local km.
methodology.edge_note: The ≥1 mm/h storm footprint touches the domain boundary; area and motion may be truncated.
methodology.classification_note: Demonstration archetype labels describe chosen generator parameters; they are not inferred or validated storm classifications. Imported data is unclassified.
methodology.sampling_note: Modeled examples sample 25 rainfall intervals. Fast, narrow storms may be undersampled, especially at long durations; changing duration also changes the timestep. Imported data retains its submitted regular interval.
methodology.geographic_note: Generated rainfall is placed in a 100 x 100 km UTM Zone 13N grid around Denver. The published MHFD district outline is an interim geographic proxy, not the provided study boundary. Metrics use the entire rectangular grid and planar UTM areas; the outline does not mask or recalculate rainfall. Bearings are relative to UTM grid north. Background imagery is geographic context, not storm-time imagery.
